g.text: BankDash Transactions Ledger Interaction & Animation Locators
Visual mapping of 6 key interactive zones across the complete transaction history view
Dual 3D Parallax Tilt Cards + Balance Counter
Real-time mouse tilt with specular lighting reflection & rolling balance counter
TRIGGER: Hovering over cards / Initial page load
Monthly Expense Bar Stagger + Hover Tooltip
12-month bars grow smoothly with staggered delays, color pop, and tooltips
TRIGGER: Page load / Hovering monthly bars
Sliding Tab Indicator + Instant Ledger Filter
Fluid indicator transition between All, Income, and Expense tabs with row fade-in
TRIGGER: Clicking tab filters
Search Input Expansion & Real-Time Filter
Glow ring on focus, instant keystroke debounced filtering & row re-animation
TRIGGER: Focus & typing in search bar
Row Glide, Directional Icon Pop & Receipt Modal
Row hover elevation, green/red income/expense badge pulse,
and interactive Download Receipt modal dialog with print preview
TRIGGER: Hovering rows / Clicking receipt button
Smooth Page Flip + Active Page Bubble Glow
Dynamic page state transition, row slide effect, and disabled button handling
TRIGGER: Clicking Previous, Next, or page numbers
KEY INTERACTIONS SUMMARY:
Cards: 3D Tilt
Expense: Bar Stagger
Tabs: Sliding Indicator
Search: Debounced Glow
Table: Glide & Receipt
Pagination: Active Glow
All interactions use GPU hardware-accelerated transforms & zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0.00) with accessible aria controls.
